d: Room in the duke's palace in Belvedere. Paggi, Scudieri, Cortigiani, indi Ernesto.
Garden in the ducal palace. In the background flows Po.Parisina, Imelda, and Damigelle.
Knights armed with all arms: some with lowered visor. Shields carrying spears and shields. Parisina, and Imelda.
Ugo removes his visor; Parisina recognizes him.
Imelda and the bridesmaids hasty, then Azzo, Ernesto, and Suguito.
Afar choir of Battellieri sul Po.
Parisina's Cabinet. Alcove closed by silk curtains. It is night. The place is lit by two candlesticks. Imelda, and Damigelle.

Gallery in the ducal palace, which puts to various illuminated apartments, where the festival takes place. Music expresses the celebration that is done there. Dame, Knights cross the gallery and from the gallery the apartments.
Vestibule that puts to the towers of the ducal palace. Azzo, and Guards.
Ugo, and Parisina from various parts between the Guards and said.
Land gallery in the ducal palace. On one side domestic chapel. In the background Gothic closed windows. Damsel of Parisina and Knights.
